title: Configure automx
description: Settings for automx (DESIGN.md 6.1/7): service host override, http2https default, display-names toggle. All optional; an omitted field keeps its current value. Accepts null or {} so the admin UI can call it with no payload just to (re)apply current settings.

service_host.description: CNAME/SRV target and Autodiscover host override. Null means "use the node's own FQDN" (DESIGN.md 5.1).

display_names.title: Include display names
display_names.description: Include the LDAP-looked-up display name in autoconfig responses. The autoconfig/autodiscover/mobileconfig endpoints are unauthenticated by protocol design, so this is address-to-name disclosure for whoever asks (DESIGN.md 8); on by default, matching normal client behavior.
